title: SMB: display bytes before total data count
description:
In TRANS2 SET_FILE_INFO requests, display the bytes remaining
until the Total Data Count is reached. Do so in the Packet List
and Packet Detail.

NOTE: This change is primarly designed for SET_FILE_INFO requests
that require "Secondary" requests due to a large amount of data to
be sent. Contact me if you would like a sample capture.
